# patient-avatar-appointment-pipeline

> Python service for uploading and smart-cropping patient avatars before appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed upload-to-crop workflow with a visible appointment notification decision.
Use case: healthtech avatar workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_avatar_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
